faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins is 300 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $1.40/pc (300 pcs starter tier), $0.82/pc (500 pcs tier), and $0.55/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins is $65 Die (Waived @ 500+ pcs). Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins?
faqs.answer: Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins is custom-engineered from Die-Struck Iron / Zinc Alloy using Phosphorescent Luminous Enamel Pigment Fill, sized around 35×32×1.6mm at approximately 12g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Black Nickel / Gunmetal / Chrome. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins?
faqs.answer: This custom format ships with 2× Black Rubber Clutches. Upgrade hardware options such as deluxe locking pin clutches, magnetic no-hole bar clasps, custom split rings, or velvet presentation boxes can be specified in your quote.

faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins completes in 9–12 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins?
faqs.answer: Beyond complimentary individual polybags, Custom Glow-in-the-Dark Enamel Pins can be packaged onto custom printed 350gsm retail backing cards, sealed inside clear acrylic coin capsules, or presented in flocked velvet gift boxes.
